free_tier.stated: 'New accounts get EUR 50 in free credits, valid for one year. That's roughly 312 hours of async transcription on solaria-3, 185 hours on solaria-1, or 73 hours of real-time.' The amount is printed with a euro sign on the vendor page and is written here as EUR 50. The price card is 'Starts at EUR 0.16/hour', with async tiers from EUR 0.27 an hour at 0 to 100 hours down to EUR 0.21 at 10,000+ hours, and real-time from EUR 0.16 to EUR 0.12.

retention.stated: the wallet is one year: unused credit is lost 12 months after signup, so a 312-hour allowance is a 12-month budget and not a reserve; a project that starts in month 11 gets one month of transcription.

What breaks: the one-year clock, and the 73-hour real-time figure, which is a quarter of the async allowance because real-time bills the connection rather than the audio.
